overall_quality.evidence: Virtual memory is a system that allows a computer to use a combination of physical RAM and disk space to store and manage data. It works by temporarily moving data from RAM to the hard drive when the system runs out of physical memory. This process is transparent to the user, and the system can handle more data than the physical memory alone would allow.
